prompt: I want to add a new OAS schema type — OasDateTime — to handle the OpenAPI 'format: date-time' case explicitly instead of treating it as a generic OasString. Since dates are conceptually a kind of string, should OasDateTime extend OasString, or should I make it a separate sibling alongside OasObject / OasArray / OasString / OasRef / etc.? Show me what the class shape should look like.
